label: DEV_ONLY_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_EVALUATED
definition: PC 8 + checkpoint one-hot; two binary heads; score = q_R - q_C (supervised success-value baseline, no Bellman backup)
decision_rule: R5 if score > 0, otherwise Continue. 0 is the expected-net-gain boundary, not a harm tolerance. No threshold, penalty or regularisation search.
fitted_on: all 36 development scenes of Stage 2B and 2D (the same scenes whose leave-one-scene-out results were already seen)

input.order: StandardScaler(policy_feature) -> PCA(8) -> StandardScaler(PC scores) -> append checkpoint one-hot [12, 52, 92, 132]
